notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
CHAT (FastAPI) and INTERACTION (Flask) read PostgreSQL; INTERACTION (Flask) also enqueues SQS tasks, starts Temporal workflows and makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
Temporal workflows read PostgreSQL and enqueue SQS tasks.
